title: A Comprehensive Survey on Visual Question Answering Datasets and Algorithms

bias_targets.target: Statistical bias and Language priors (Dataset bias)
bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys methods for evaluating and reducing spurious correlations and language priors in Visual Question Answering (VQA). Methodologies include analyzing answer distributions for skewed results (e.g., default "yes" or "2" answers), balancing datasets with complementary image-question pairs (e.g., VQA-v2), using question-only (bias-only) models in adversarial training or ensembles to isolate and penalize language bias, enforcing visual grounding through attention supervision to ensure the model looks at the image, and augmenting datasets with counterfactual samples generated by masking or modifying text and image regions.
